name: git-graph
description: Git history as a graph: a colour per lane, HEAD/branches/remotes/tags as badges, then hash, subject, author and date. Pass what `git log --graph --oneline --decorate` printed; add --all for every branch and --format="%h%d %s (%an, %ar)" for author and date. Use to show branching, merges and where branches stand.
